Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Ropar is 30th August 2026. Ensure all your details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech in Mechanical and M.Tech in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering/Applied Mechanics with a GATE score, or an exceptional B.Tech/B.E in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering with a valid GATE score and at least 60% marks or 6.0 CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive as per the provided information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve two stages: initial shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview for the final selection.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow at IIT Ropar is a contractual role, offering a specific term of employment.

faq.question: Q6. Where is IIT Ropar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar is located in Rupnagar, Punjab, with the pincode 140001.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive by IIT Ropar.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Ropar must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for this information.

faq.answer: In addition to the essential qualifications, knowledge of MATLAB, Fortran, or Abaqus is considered desirable for the Junior Research Fellow position.
